Six16CPU dynamic refill with1.2 memory reservation plus16GiB guard and liveRSS. Six16GiB tests plus64GiB map forecasts, not claimed new measured peaks. Original337 and R311/342 continue normally. New numerical cycles require fresh S/V workspace, occupancy and finite budget measurement later; no old physical acceptance transfer. New group130bit proof includes actual single-bit negative; unchanged304 add/RNE proof remains separate
